decision.author: albanD
decision.body:
I don't think we should do that.
gradcheck with anything below fp64 will have such high tolerance that you won't be able to see actual errors.
For lower precision dtype, you should compare against a cpu reference. So that the chain of trust is:
- cpu fp64 is validated with gradcheck
- cpu fp32/fp16/etc is validated against cpu fp64
- accelerator fp32/fp16/etc is validated against the corresponding cpu dtype
